model.name: YOLOv8 pose candidate
model.sourceUrl: owner-required official or self-trained YOLOv8 pose model source
model.onnxExportCommand: yolo export model=yolov8n-pose.pt format=onnx imgsz=640 opset=17 simplify=True dynamic=False

input.preprocessCommand: owner-required command that performs resize/letterbox/RGB/normalize/NCHW conversion

postprocessMetadata.poseDecodeRule: owner-required keypoint coordinate scale and visibility rule

commands.yoloVisionRunCommand: dotnet run --project .\samples\YoloVision -- --model .\models\yolov8-pose.onnx --labels .\models\coco-pose.names --input-data .\models\yolov8-pose-fp32.bin --input-shape 1x3x640x640 --tensor-rt-line 10 --family v8 --task pose --keypoint-count 17 --keypoint-layout x,y,confidence --layout auto --has-objectness auto --nms-mode class-aware --confidence 0.25 --iou-threshold 0.45

requiredEvidenceLines: Profile Family=v8 Task=Pose Layout=... Nms=... NmsMode=class-aware
proofChecklist.notProofUntil: owner backfills real assets for pose, keypoint metadata, hashes, run log, stdout/stderr summaries, and validator passes
proofChecklist.packageConsumerBoundary: This candidate can support real-model-runtime only; package-consumer-runtime must come from clean external package consumer validators.
